entities.summary:
Corentin of Quimper (b. 375 CE, Cornouaille) was a renowned entrepreneur and business leader of the Classical era, active in Cornouaille. He is known for his influential role in shaping the religious landscape of the region. Corentin's entrepreneurial prowess and religious affiliations earned him a significant place in the annals of Cornouaille's history.

Corentin's business acumen and connections with key figures in the region helped establish a strong foundation for the local economy. His religious convictions and leadership played a crucial role in the development of the Cornouaille's spiritual infrastructure.

The legacy of Corentin of Quimper can be seen in the enduring influence of his business practices and religious ideology on the region. His entrepreneurial spirit and commitment to his faith have inspired generations of leaders and entrepreneurs in Cornouaille.

Corentin's influence on the region's spiritual landscape is still felt today, with his legacy serving as a reminder of the importance of faith and commerce in shaping the course of human history.
